name: cold-kit-configs
goal: A cold checkout collects every root unit test: SvelteKit package configs that root tests resolve are generated before Vitest collects.

evidence: Cold 17a: root Vitest resolves the tsconfig of imported package modules; hub and reports tsconfig extend .svelte-kit/tsconfig.json, which no install or root step generates before test:unit.
Unchanged 17a, cold after bun install: record-lineage.test.ts and seed-attacher.test.ts each exit 1, no tests collected, TSConfckParseError extends ./.svelte-kit/tsconfig.json (hub, reports).
vitest.config.ts globalSetup test/svelteKitConfigs.ts: runs svelte-kit sync only in packages whose tsconfig extends the missing generated config. Tests, config resolution and deadlines unchanged.

Same unchanged tests cold: record-lineage 6/6, seed-attacher 2/2, new unit 2/2. Entire root unit suite cold after build:kernel: 198 files passed, 2 skipped; 779 tests. Guard: setup removed fails, restored passes.
